subject: Next steps & VP/CTO intro — DeviceCo discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@deviceco.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & VP/CTO intro — DeviceCo discovery follow-up

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have shared alignment and clear next steps: 

Summary (short):
- Primary goal: validate performance & cost tradeoffs for DeviceCo's real-time recommendation pipeline and confirm pilot gating criteria.
- Key constraints: 95th-percentile latency target <= 120ms, on-prem data retention for PII, and per-request encryption keys.
- Expected users: 50–150 QPS during peak, bursts to 300 QPS; majority of inference on 8k token contexts for personalization model.

Open items we agreed to action:
1) Schedule an exec intro (VP / CTO level) to make deployment decision and sign off on pilot scope — target 30 minutes.
2) Schedule a technical deep dive with infra + ML engineering (60–90 minutes) to review runbook and integration points.
3) Share security/compliance artifacts and preliminary mutual action plan (attached).

Proposed scheduling windows (PT):
- Exec intro (30m): Tue 12 Oct 9:00–9:30 OR Tue 12 Oct 16:00–16:30
- Technical deep dive (60–90m): Wed 13 Oct 11:00–12:30 OR Thu 14 Oct 13:00–14:30

Attachments: Aditya_Redwood_Discovery_Recap.pdf (short recap), MAP_DeviceCo_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft).

If those windows don't work, tell me two windows that fit Daniel and Alex and we will prioritize. I can bring our Head of Solutions (Priyom) and a senior infra engineer (Grace) on the tech call.

Thanks — looking forward to locking dates so we can get the pilot runway started.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Aditya — solid recap. We're aligned on the goals and appreciate the MAP. 

Quick answers:
- Daniel (CTO) is available Tue 12 Oct 9:00–10:30 PT; he can do a 30-min touch at 9:00 or a 45-min if needed.
- For the deep technical session, Alex (infra lead) prefers Wed 13 Oct 11:00–12:00 PT — that's ideal.

Let's lock those two: exec intro Tue 12 Oct 9:00–9:30 PT (Daniel + Samantha + Aditya + Priyom), technical deep dive Wed 13 Oct 11:00–12:15 PT (full infra + model owners + Redwood SE).

Action for you: please send calendar invites and the final runbook you’ll use for the tech session (we'll circulate to our SRE and security reviewers ahead). Also confirm whether Redwood requires any network prep on our side (VPN/IP allowlist).

Appreciate it — cc'ing Alex and Daniel to confirm their calendars.

Best,
Samantha
